card.name: Digits in dates of Chinese leaders
card.fires_on: Single digits inside years, mostly birth and death years in brackets after Chinese leaders' names such as Deng Xiaoping and Mao Zedong. It also fires weakly on words near Communist Party in China texts.

modes.label: Lifespan years
modes.description: A digit inside a bracketed birth-death year range after a Chinese leader's name.

modes.label: Event years
modes.description: A digit in a year in text about Chinese Communist Party history.
modes.example: Hu Jintao, now the head of both China's Communist Party and its government, was brought to Beijing by Deng in 19<<8>>9

modes.label: Party slogan or name
modes.description: A word in a Communist Party phrase or a quote about China.
modes.example: Without the Communist<< Party>> There Would Be No New China.

card.writes: No clear meaning; it weakly favors odd name-like pieces and discourages Chinese political slogan words.
card.plain: It lights up on the digits of years in bracketed lifespans of Chinese Communist leaders.
